_about: Alarm seat pack for build_knowledge_v2.py: every value is the constant or text build_knowledge_v1.py has in its code (SCOUT 2026-11-08, playground). With this pack v2 writes the same brief and check output as v1, byte for byte (test_build_knowledge_v2.py TGolden). Keys starting with _ are comments.
_mechanisms: ids of team/RESEARCH/LEAD/MECHANISM_20261106/MECHANISM_MAP_V1.md (sha16 36faecd0eaa59b85); a new name needs a map row first, then this list (C20)

base_rates.pass_line: - R1 met the pass rule's margin and t parts (margin >= +2 over the same-side yardstick, t >= 3; the months part is not stored): {n} of {total} runs ({runs}); start p(R1 passes) from this share
extra_lines: - Yardsticks by month (Sep-Jan, lead15; receipts 20270734 YARDSTICK_FDONLY_BLOCKS row SEPJAN, 20270844 YARDSTICK_FUONLY_SEPJAN): FDONLY Sep +26.02, Oct +5.62, Nov +6.68, Dec +1.82, Jan +8.27; FUONLY Sep +4.81, Oct +10.49, Nov +9.21, Dec +18.95, Jan +9.46. The R1 rule's months part compares each of your months with the one pooled number (+8.09 or +10.99), never with these per-month values, which only show which months are hard (C127, C128).

- lead15 = points: (lean win rate minus the matched random moments' win rate) x 100 at 15 min, counted per wave; se = lead / t. Power line: halves have se about se x sqrt(2) each, so the gap needed for t 2.5 is about 2.5 x 2 x se.

intro_lines: Built by build_knowledge_v1.py brief from EVIDENCE.tsv, FINDINGS.tsv, MOVES.tsv, OPEN_QUESTIONS.tsv; do not edit by hand.

Why: team/RESEARCH/plans/PLAN_KNOWLEDGE_FORMAT_20261107.md. Numbers are Sep 2025 to Jan 2026 (design window) unless the line says otherwise; yardsticks at 15 min: FDONLY Sep-Jan +8.09 (down side, E0001), FUONLY Sep-Jan +10.99 (up side, FORCED_OUT_SHORTS, E0051).

Status by numbers only: SUPPORTED = t >= 2.5 and >= 300 waves in one run, or an R3 built on it beats R1 and FDONLY; CONFIRMED also needs >= 2 runs and >= 2 mechanisms and the orchestrator's held-out read. A mechanism is the evidence row's mechanism name, set by the side and the flow it fades: FORCED_OUT (down move), FORCED_OUT_SHORTS (up move), CROWDED_LATE; a setup without forced-flow legs takes its side's name (C48).

Cite finding ids (Fnnnn) in every claim. Each finding line leads with status, runs, mechanisms (names) and the best numbers per mechanism; only the statement is capped at {LINE_CAP} characters; full text in FINDINGS.tsv.
_intro_lines: the Built-by line keeps the v1 name so the alarm brief stays byte-identical; change it to build_knowledge_v2.py when the alarm seat moves to v2 (the brief then differs by that one line)
